name: scott-skills
description: Scott Chang's Claude Code plugins: the ss-workflow request workflow, WPF and design skills, and bundled third-party skills (anthropics/skills, taste-skill, claude-plugins-official LSP plugins)

plugins.name: ss-workflow
plugins.description: Request-driven gitflow workflow skills for a workspace that wraps projects as git submodules: init, new/check request, review, merge, and release

plugins.name: ss-wpf
plugins.description: WPF desktop application skills: MVVM with CommunityToolkit.Mvvm (or a hand-written base for old toolchains), and Material Design with MaterialDesignThemes

plugins.name: ss-design
plugins.description: Technology-independent design principles (the object-oriented design examples are in C# 7.3): object-oriented design (responsibilities, SOLID, patterns, domain model, refactoring) and UI/UX design (easy to use or easy to learn, flows, layout, forms, accessibility), with review checklists

plugins.name: ss-build
plugins.description: Build and release helpers for Windows projects: a version generator that takes the version from git tags (C# and C++ with MSBuild), and a release package script that zips the release build, with the requests or edits that set them up in a project

plugins.name: ss-firmware
plugins.description: Firmware skills in C: a layered, function-based architecture with struct and function pointer objects (OOD in C) for ESP32 (ESP-IDF), STM32 (HAL), Nordic (nRF Connect SDK), NXP (MCUXpresso SDK), and FX2/FX3 USB controllers, with host-side unit tests and a review checklist

plugins.name: taste-skill
plugins.description: Art direction, reference images and a browser check for professional company websites instead of generic AI pages (leonxlnx/taste-skill, MIT)

plugins.name: ui-skills
plugins.description: Skills for design engineers: clean up UI code and fix accessibility, metadata, and motion performance issues (ibelick/ui-skills, MIT)

plugins.name: document-skills
plugins.description: Collection of document processing suite including Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and PDF capabilities

plugins.name: cc-skills
plugins.description: Anthropic's practical skills for Claude Code and Claude: skill creation, MCP server building, frontend design, web app testing, web artifacts, canvas and brand design, themes, algorithmic art, Slack GIFs, document co-authoring, and internal communications (example-skills upstream)

plugins.name: llm-api
plugins.description: Claude API and SDK documentation skill for building LLM-powered applications

plugins.name: academy-guide
plugins.description: Recommends relevant Claude Academy courses, tutorials, and use cases when users ask how to use Claude

plugins.name: discernment-nudge
plugins.description: Appends two or three short follow-up questions after a substantive answer to help users check key facts, probe the reasoning, and notice missing context
